mobile-feature.description: Bounded Mobile JS/TS validation: cloud contracts and full Jest; native package and device evidence remain independent CI/maintainer checks.

checks.command: set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/22.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm ci
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/22.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run typecheck
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/22.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm run lint

set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/22.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm test -- --runInBand src/cloud
set -e; NODE_BIN="$(find /opt/hostedtoolcache/node -path '*/22.*/x64/bin/node' -print | sort -V | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$NODE_BIN"; export PATH="$(dirname "$NODE_BIN"):$PATH"; npm test -- --runInBand
